subtitles.en: You think about the large auditoriums. That's where people want to see the Odyssey.
subtitles.zh: 想想那些大型影厅，人们就想在那里看《奥德赛》。

subtitles.en: It's very hard to do. I mean there's been viral social media posts that even if you want to see a 2am, a 3am screening, it's sold out. You can't get in. So, I mean, is there a plan to expand
subtitles.zh: 这很难做到。社交媒体上疯传，即使你想看凌晨两三点场次，也售罄了，进不去。

subtitles.en: this to more theaters, more auditoriums around the world?
subtitles.zh: 那么，有没有计划在全球更多影院和影厅扩大放映？

subtitles.en: So I've got to divide it into pieces. One is there's lots of availability in IMAX globally and we have about 2,000 screens. A subset of that is film screens because Chris Nolan was the first director
subtitles.zh: 我得分开说。一是IMAX全球有很多可用影厅，我们约有2000块银幕。其中一部分是胶片银幕，因为克里斯托弗·诺兰是首位全程用IMAX摄像机拍摄整部电影的导演。

subtitles.en: to ever film an entire movie with IMAX cameras. So if you want to see it captured in IMAX film, projected in film, you could only do that at the film theaters. Our network overall is done
subtitles.zh: 所以，如果你想看用IMAX胶片拍摄并投影的版本，只能在胶片影院观看。我们的整体网络表现很好。

subtitles.en: very well. It's a record opening for us. We did 52 million dollars on a like-for-like basis, the highest we've ever had. And in fact it was almost 50% above Oppenheimer but you know,
subtitles.zh: 对我们来说这是创纪录的开画。按可比口径，我们取得了5200万美元，是史上最高。实际上比《奥本海默》高出近50%，而《奥本海默》后来大获成功。

subtitles.en: went on to be a huge success. So the question is about there are lots of IMAX digital theaters,
subtitles.zh: 所以问题在于，有很多IMAX数字影院，但胶片影院很少。

subtitles.en: the film ones are rare. In a way though those theaters are like the Rolls Royce and the economics around them are very high and you have to put them in a very big auditorium with a very big
subtitles.zh: 不过，这些胶片影院就像劳斯莱斯，经济效益很高，必须放在非常大的影厅里。

subtitles.en: special to me. Screen, film prints are $50,000 for one print at one theater. So you have to get
subtitles.zh: 对我来说很特别。一块银幕的胶片拷贝要5万美元。所以你必须得到……

The film is officially titled 《奥本海默》 in Chinese.
